name: tokensaver
description: Avoid costly returns to large subscription main threads with local cache-age checks and bounded handoffs. Built by Freshwater Futures.

interface.shortDescription: Guard against costly returns to large main threads.
interface.longDescription: TokenSaver guards against accidentally resuming large subscription main conversations after a long break. Defaults assume 60 minutes for Claude Code within included subscription usage and 30 minutes for Codex with GPT-5.6 or later. Cache age is estimated, not confirmed expiry. Checks run locally without network or model calls and save a bounded handoff for a manually opened fresh session. Built by Freshwater Futures, combining behavioural science and AI engineering to help organisations turn AI inertia into AI impact.
